messages.en:
You've {01 00 00 05 00}got too much stuff!
Look at yourself... {07 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}You 
can't even carry it all!
{07 16 00}Come back when your back 
isn't buckling from carrying
so much stuff, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Sul on {01 00 00 05 00}liiga palju kraami!
Vaata ennast... {07 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Sa ei
suuda seda kõike kandagi!
{07 16 00}Tule tagasi, kui su selg
ei murdu kraamikoorma
all, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Hey! You can't carry any
more! Your pockets are
overflowing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Get rid of all that junk, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}, then come see
me!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Hei! Sa ei suuda rohkem
kanda! Su taskud on
puupüsti täis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Vabane sellest rämpsust,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}, ja tule siis
minu juurde!
